items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Does that say PAL or does that say something else. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. “Have you got a video, pal.” Funny.

ctx.x: but I don’t think I really miss it. I don’t think that’s the right sentence. All that drudgery. Plus the fact that I wound up in the position where I couldn’t read my own writing so I don’t know how anyone else did. It’s got worse and worst. My copyist used to say, “I can read your musical stuff but it’s the directions that I haven’t a clue what you’ve written — make a guess at, does that say ‘adagio’ or ‘allegro’ or what does it say?”
Does that say PAL or does that say something else.
Yes. “Have you got a video, pal.” Funny.
